name: Shojo-tan: Dai 1-maku Goshujin-sama ni Shojo o Sasageru Kenage na Maid Hen
original_name: しょじょたん 第1幕 ご主人様に処女を捧げる健気なメイド編
source:
Maid wants to establish true master-slave relations. For her dedicating virginity to her master is a proof of loyalty, a trial on the way to becoming a full-fledged maid. And the long-awaited day has come.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-january-2008-fortune.html]vndbreview[/url]]
